reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing media tool for DSH that enables OCR and image understanding workflows, then presents image-related results directly in the web interface. It exposes image-processing tools and augments existing tool-result cards with inline previews, making image-heavy interactions easier for end users, with local OCR and local model-backed viewing configured at runtime.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH 的网页插件，提供本地图片文字识别与图片理解工具（如 ocr_image 与 view_image），并在工具结果卡片中内嵌显示图片缩略图和放大预览。
summaries.en: This DSH web plugin provides local image OCR and image-understanding tools (such as ocr_image and view_image) and shows inline image previews in tool-result cards.

capabilities: image preview rendering in web tool cards
integration with host tools for read_image/screenshot

reasons.code: README describes two primary tools: ocr_image (OCR text+coordinates) and view_image (local image understanding/Q&A), both designed for image processing.
README states the plugin adds inline image previews (thumbnail + lightbox) to read_image/screenshot/view_image/ocr_image tool-result cards in the web UI.
package.json defines a web client bundle and host/client entry points for DSH, confirming plugin execution path and UI integration.

capabilities: image preview rendering in web tool cards
